Requirement_Description: Institutional Review Board (IRB) / IEC Protocol Approval or Exemption
Required_Artifact: Stamped IRB Approval Letter with Protocol ID
Verification_Procedure: Audit inspection of signed IRB determination memo
Stop_Condition: Recruiting participants or accessing patient audio without IRB approval

Requirement_Description: Informed Consent and Participant Information Sheet Specification
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: ICH-GCP E6(R2) Section 4.8 / India DPDP Act 2023 Sec 6
Required_Artifact: Accessible Participant Consent Form (Grade 6-8 reading level)
Verification_Procedure: Review of consent template against accessibility and biometric criteria
Stop_Condition: Participant enrollment without documented accessible consent

Requirement_Description: Bilateral Data Use Agreement with Speech Accessibility Project (UIUC)
Required_Artifact: Countersigned Bilateral DUA executed by Authorized Official
Verification_Procedure: Legal verification of bilateral signature blocks and permitted use
Stop_Condition: Ingesting or processing external dataset without executed bilateral DUA

Requirement_Description: Academic Data Request Dossier for UA-Speech Corpus
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: UIUC Statistical Speech Technology Group License Terms
Required_Artifact: Formal Request Form with Institutional Email and Cloud Drive
Verification_Procedure: Verification of custodian confirmation email and LICENSE.txt receipt
Stop_Condition: Downloading or using third-party unverified derivative versions (e.g. Kaggle)

Requirement_Description: Formal Appointment of Licensed CCC-SLP Clinical Lead
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: ASHA Code of Ethics / National Speech-Language Board Licensure
Required_Artifact: Active Professional Licensure Verification & Appointment Letter
Verification_Procedure: Inspection of state/national professional licensure and signed terms of reference
Stop_Condition: Making clinical safety determinations without qualified CCC-SLP signoff

Requirement_Description: Clinical Intent Annotation Protocol & Adjudication Rules
Required_Artifact: Standard Operating Procedure for Emergency Intent Annotation
Stop_Condition: Assigning emergency labels without clinical SLP adjudication protocol

Requirement_Description: Clinical Safety Case Risk-Benefit Evaluation Signoff
Required_Artifact: Clinical Risk-Benefit Assessment Memo with Signoff
Verification_Procedure: Formal review of Hazard Analysis and Clinical Validation Plan
Stop_Condition: Representing system as clinically viable with observed 80% miss rate

Requirement_Description: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for Voice Biometrics
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: India DPDP Act 2023 / EU GDPR Art 35 / US State Biometric Laws
Required_Artifact: Completed DPIA Document with Risk Mitigation Matrix
Verification_Procedure: Verification of DPIA approval by institutional data privacy officer
Stop_Condition: Processing voice biometric audio without documented DPIA

Requirement_Description: Encryption at Rest and in Transit for External Audio Storage
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: ISO 27001 A.10 / NIST SP 800-52 / AES-256 BitLocker
Verification_Procedure: Automated inspection of volume encryption status and loopback binding
Stop_Condition: Storing speech recordings on unencrypted volumes or public cloud

Requirement_Description: Role-Based Access Control and Tamper-Evident Access Logging
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: ISO 27001 A.9 / HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312
Required_Artifact: POSIX RBAC Configuration and Audit Event Log Daemon
Verification_Procedure: Audit log generation verification test on dataset access
Stop_Condition: Permitting unauthorized or unlogged access to participant audio

Requirement_Description: Data Retention Minimization and Certified Erasure Workflow
Required_Artifact: Certified Data Destruction Protocol with Cryptographic Sanitization
Verification_Procedure: Validation of temp file purging and post-study secure erasure script
Stop_Condition: Retaining participant speech beyond authorized DUA term

Requirement_Description: Public Public Registry Preregistration Deposit (OSF / ClinicalML)
Applicable_Statute_Or_Standard: ICMJE Preregistration Guidelines / Open Science Framework
Required_Artifact: Preregistration Deposit Receipt with DOI and Protocol Hash
Verification_Procedure: Verification of OSF timestamp and SHA-256 match with repo protocol
Stop_Condition: Conducting confirmatory evaluation prior to public preregistration lock
